annotations.title: List a manufacturer’s products and current documents

description: Use this when someone wants all products or all data sheets of one manufacturer that publishes on ProofPass. Lists the public products of one checked manufacturer with their current documents (kind, language, version, revision date, PDF URL), 25 per page. / Listet die Produkte eines Herstellers mit ihren aktuellen Dokumenten. Do not use for a single product (use search_products or resolve_product) or for the person's own account (use list_my_products).

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.

manufacturer.description: Manufacturer slug, the part after /hersteller/ in the address

name: list_manufacturer_documents
title: List a manufacturer’s products and current documents
